svg.title: Trefoil — one continuous line, three crossings
svg.desc: The (2,3) torus knot: rho = 2 + cos 3t, theta = 2t. Drawn as 110 ordered chunks, each a ground-coloured casing plus an ink core, sorted by the tube coordinate cos(3t) so the nearer strand paints last -- which is what makes the three crossings OCCLUDE. Without occlusion a trefoil is topologically indistinguishable from three overlapping loops, and that is exactly how an earlier single-stroke version rendered. Casings are butt-capped and span only their own segment; cores overlap by one point so the joins are seamless. GENERATED.
